questions.stem: How are energy flow and nutrient cycling different in ecosystems?

options.text: Energy is recycled but nutrients flow in one direction
Both energy and nutrients are recycled continuously
Energy flows in one direction through trophic levels and is lost as heat, while nutrients are recycled
Neither energy nor nutrients are recycled in ecosystems

questions.explanation: Energy flows in one direction through an ecosystem - from producers to consumers - and is lost as heat at each trophic level through respiration. Nutrients, however, are recycled through processes like decomposition, the carbon cycle, and the nitrogen cycle.
